crossref.query: molecular property chemical property property graph neural network GNN message passing neural network message passing drug discovery molecular discovery
notes: Crossref REST API 无 AND/OR/短语布尔语义；空格分隔词串按相关度匹配，概念块的 AND/OR 结构无法在服务端表达，需客户端后置过滤
多词 term 的词序与短语约束在此方言中丢失（见 query_lint QL001）

europepmc.dialect: Europe PMC query syntax (TITLE_ABS, AND/OR, FIRST_PDATE)
europepmc.query: (TITLE_ABS:"molecular property" OR TITLE_ABS:"chemical property" OR TITLE_ABS:property) AND (TITLE_ABS:"graph neural network" OR TITLE_ABS:GNN OR TITLE_ABS:"message passing neural network" OR TITLE_ABS:"message passing") AND (TITLE_ABS:"drug discovery" OR TITLE_ABS:"molecular discovery") AND FIRST_PDATE:[2024-01-01 TO 2026-06-30]
notes: 块内 OR、块间 AND；短语用双引号锁定词序

arxiv.query: (all:"molecular property" OR all:"chemical property" OR all:property) AND (all:"graph neural network" OR all:GNN OR all:"message passing neural network" OR all:"message passing") AND (all:"drug discovery" OR all:"molecular discovery") AND submittedDate:[202401010000 TO 202606302359]
notes: arXiv 不支持通配符 *（见 query_lint QL004）
all: 覆盖标题/摘要/作者等字段；如需限定摘要用 abs:
